title: Derived transport from the affine spectrum to the localized open site
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $U$ an affine open, $R=\Gamma(U,\mathcal O_X)$, and choose derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] of sheaf modules on $\operatorname{Spec}(R)$ and on the localized site over $U$. There is an equivalence $E:D(\mathcal O_{\operatorname{Spec}(R)})\simeq D(\mathcal O_U)$ with a natural isomorphism $E\circ Q\circ\widetilde{(-)}^{\bullet}\cong Q\circ F_U^{\bullet}$, where $F_U$ is the explicit affine sheafification functor described in [lem-pc-affine-perfect-module-model].

source.place: isLocalizedEquivalence_of_unit_of_unit and isEquivalence; Mathlib/Algebra/Homology/DerivedCategory/ExactFunctor.lean, mapDerivedCategoryFactors; affine-site identification in Tag 06Z0

proof.text: Build the ordinary sheaf equivalence from restriction along isoSpec.hom and isoSpec.inv, and then overEquiv.inverse, exactly as in the construction of F_U. Equivalences preserve limits and colimits and therefore binary biproducts; additive_of_preservesBinaryBiproducts supplies additivity.

Use mapHomologicalComplexUpToQuasiIsoLocalizerMorphism for the functor and inverse. The unit and inverse counit of their complex equivalence are pointwise quasi-isomorphisms. Apply LocalizerMorphism.isLocalizedEquivalence_of_unit_of_unit and isEquivalence to the derived functor with the square given by mapDerivedCategoryFactors. Use asEquivalence to bundle it.

Whisker mapDerivedCategoryFactors with termwise tilde, then compose with mapHomologicalComplexCompIso and associators. Since F_U is the actual composite tilde followed by the sheaf equivalence, this produces the stated natural comparison.

theorem affine_localized_site_derived_transport (X : Scheme.{u}) (U : X.Opens)
    (hU : IsAffineOpen U)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wS} (SheafOfModules.{u}
      (moduleRings (Spec (X.presheaf.obj (.op U))).toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))] :
    ∃ E : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u}
        (moduleRings (Spec (X.presheaf.obj (.op U))).toRingedSpace)) ≌
        DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U)),
      Nonempty ((@Functor.mapHomologicalComplex _ _ _ _ _ _ _
        (@id (ModuleCat.{u} (X.presheaf.obj (.op U)) ⥤
          SheafOfModules.{u}
            (moduleRings (Spec (X.presheaf.obj (.op U))).toRingedSpace))
          (tilde.functor (X.presheaf.obj (.op U)))) ⟨fun _ _ ↦ tilde.map_zero⟩
          (.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Q) ⋙ E.functor ≅
        (affinePerfectSheafification X U hU).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) ⋙
          DerivedCategory.Q)
